title: The First Reopening Gate
subtitle: Aten Ra vertical slice battlefield standard

canonDecision.rationale: Current onboarding starts with Aten Ra and the first deity. The battlefield teaches Gate law, solar judgment terrain, one-deity combat, and the massive-Gate fantasy without inventing a new faction or replacing lore.

battlefieldSize.mobileRationale: Compact enough for phone control, dense enough to support entry, open, chokepoint, terrain, objective, elite, and boss zones.

zones.name: Broken Threshold
zones.purpose: Gate arrival cinematic and movement tutorial
zones.story: The first deity emerges through a fractured Earth-side Gate courtyard.

zones.name: Sun-Cracked Causeway
zones.purpose: Open mobility route with ranged exposure

zones.name: Fallen Pylon Choke
zones.purpose: Direct route, enemy blocking, pillar destruction

zones.name: Judgment Ray Lanes
zones.purpose: Solar terrain grants Momentum but telegraphs danger

zones.name: Solar Seal Court
zones.purpose: Primary objective: stabilize three solar seals

zones.name: Anchor Scar / Gate Mouth Arena
zones.purpose: Colossal boss phase fight beside the massive Gate

routes.description: Push through Fallen Pylon Choke; fastest path but eats ranged pressure and elite overwatch.
Circle through Broken Threshold ruins; slower, more cover, lower Momentum income.
Enter Judgment Ray Lanes, use Aten-Ra solar law to gain Momentum and trigger terrain punishment on enemies.
Break the memory obelisk for micro-lore and mastery XP before boss escalation.

terrain.name: Sunlit Stone
terrain.effect: Standing here at turn start grants +1 Momentum to Aten Ra Deitys; enemies are exposed.

terrain.name: Judgment Ray
terrain.effect: Telegraphed lane. At pulse, deals radiant damage to units inside; Aten-Ra can convert a perfect reaction into Divinity.

terrain.name: Fractured Cover
terrain.effect: Reduces ranged damage; heavy deity attacks can destroy it and open shortcuts.

terrain.name: Gate Pressure
terrain.effect: Boss arena hazard; grows during boss phases unless Solar Seals remain stable.

terrain.name: Memory Obelisk
terrain.effect: Optional interactable: unlocks micro-Codex and divine mastery XP.

interactables.name: Fallen Pylon Wall
interactables.result: Destroys cover, opens direct route, triggers one Hollow reinforcement.

interactables.name: Solar Seal A
interactables.result: Primary objective progress and reduces boss Gate Pressure.

interactables.name: Solar Seal B
interactables.result: Primary objective progress and grants Divinity spark.

interactables.name: Solar Seal C
interactables.result: Primary objective progress and weakens boss phase 2.

deitySpecificInteractions.name: Aten-Ra
rules: Can convert Judgment Ray perfect reaction into Divinity.
Solar Verdict can stabilize a Solar Seal from range 2.
Heavy monolith strike destroys pylon walls and visibly shakes the battlefield.
Can bypass the pylon choke through cracked causeway gaps but has less safe objective control.
Can hold enemies inside Judgment Ray lanes for higher tactical payoff.
Can pressure the boss early from open zone but risks caster/ranged retaliation.

encounters.name: Small Gateborn Group
encounters.teaches: movement, target priority, Deity scale vs small enemies

encounters.name: Anchor Elite
encounters.teaches: build test, elite telegraphs, reinforcement event

encounters.name: Solar Seal Objective
encounters.teaches: objective priority, danger vs reward, Divinity spend timing

encounters.name: Boss — The First Gate Colossus
encounters.teaches: complete loop: phases, hazards, terrain, resources, escalation
enemies: Colossal boss with Gate Pressure phases

boss.name: The First Gate Colossus
boss.lore: A massive Hollow pressure-shape forcing the First Reopening Gate wider. It is not a replacement faction; it is a threat born from the existing Gate rupture context.

phases.name: Awakening at the Gate Mouth
phases.mechanic: basic sweeps, summons small enemies, Gate visible in background

phases.name: Pressure Lanes
phases.mechanic: Judgment Ray lanes invert into Gate Pressure hazards unless seals are stable

phases.name: Pylon Shatter
phases.mechanic: boss destroys parts of cover, creating new routes and danger

phases.name: Colossal Verdict
phases.mechanic: large telegraphed attack; reaction success grants Momentum/Divinity window

phases.name: Solar Execution
phases.mechanic: final execution opportunity if player conserved Divinity

difficulty.changes: Learns battlefield; generous telegraphs; boss phase 5 optional execution.
Ranged enemy protects caster; Judgment Ray pulses faster; secondary objective tighter.
Elite gains guard AI, reinforcements flank, boss phase 3 destroys more cover.
Gate Pressure grows each round; Divinity timing required for clean victory.
Boss gains alternate phase order, limited healing, extra caster AI, stricter mastery rewards.
